name: Artés (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth quarters red and the second and third yellow, with a black cross throughout over the quartering.
history: The official flag of Artés is an oblong flag of 2:3, quartered with the first and fourth quarters red and the second and third yellow, with the black cross of the arms; the arms were approved on 19 October 1993 (DOGC no. 1818 of 8 November 1993) and the flag published in the DOGC in September 1994.
